description: Declarative pass/fail expectations the writer-grader checks generated test files against. Checks the actual files, never the plan that produced them.

cases.name: login
cases.description: 4-layer suite generated for the login page.

expectations.text: All 4 layers exist: pages/login_page.py, modules/login_module.py, fixtures/login_fixtures.py, specs/test_login.py
login_page.py contains only locator properties -- no assertions and no direct navigation/click calls
test_login.py is the only file containing assertions (expect(...) calls)
No hardcoded URL string appears in any of the 4 files -- TARGET_BASE_URL is imported from agents.shared.config instead
No time.sleep() call appears anywhere in the 4 files

Locators used in login_page.py match the `primary` strategy type recorded in element-map.json for the username, password, and login button elements (e.g. get_by_placeholder/get_by_role, not a raw CSS selector)
test-cases/login.testcases.md exists and its bullets correspond to actual test function names present in test_login.py, not to hypothetical/planned tests
No TODO, FIXME, or placeholder/stub function bodies (e.g. `pass` where real logic is expected) appear in any of the 4 files
